description: Array of configs of different sensors
title: Sensor Config

sensors.description: a List of Configurations of sensors

deviceAddress.description: an Address Identifying the current sensor

fieldName.description: name for the field that should be mapped from the byte buffer

datatype.description: The datatype onto which the bytes should be mapped

start.description: the position on the bytebuffer at which the fields data starts

end.description: the position on the bytebuffer at which the fields data ends

samplingRate_ms.description: The Sampling Rate of the sensor in ms, the interval within which sensordata is expected

repeatFields.description: The amount of times the fields are repeated in the buffer
